title: When Redlands Discovers Luke Hayes

title: Luke Nathan Hayes: Open Record
summary: A public record linking life history, original documents, music and projects, with source notes and a dated review of recent public work.

title: A Fair Go in the Age of Intelligence
summary: Luke's independent September 2026 contribution brings together personal agency, shared capability and international cooperation. It is an author publication, without United Nations endorsement.

title: Strange But True
summary: Luke's public doorway for practical technology help, AI guidance, speaking, media and creative work. The public-speaking page introduces A Fair Go in the Age of Superintelligence.

title: Sovereign Capacity Lab
summary: Browser research and editable scenarios connect mining, materials, electricity, storage, repairable robotics, manufacturing, housing and orbital infrastructure. Outputs retain their assumptions.

title: Joyful Responsible Abundance
summary: An educational guide to the connected proposals, a dated paper on superintelligence and Australian sovereignty, source libraries and browser calculators.

title: P4A the Purple Party for Australia
summary: The P4A civic workbench links places, everyday questions, public evidence and participation routes, including its Redlands local journey.

title: i C. infinity Music Universe
summary: The artist catalogue brings album pages, songs, lyrics, video links and creative production workbenches together with the original work and its context.

title: Aura Genesis: Original Concept
summary: The earlier single-page concept introduces a proposed personal reflection and digital-twin journey. Its registration interface is a demonstration and does not store enquiries.

title: Aura Genesis Protocol
summary: The expanded public guide covers the proposed Genesis process, Geode hardware pathways, Truth Engine research and sixty daily readings. These remain proposals and research pathways.

title: Verse Box
summary: A lower-cost public demonstration proposal for personal Aura building, learning and community participation, with a source-linked trial guide.

title: Project Atlas
summary: A searchable public project directory connecting websites and repositories, with substantive build dates, source evidence and related-project links.

title: Worldwide Contact System: Outreach CMS
summary: A public discovery workbench with invitation drafts, private contact-work design and publishing checks. Its reviewed public seed contains no confirmed resident contacts or participating communities.

title: Infinity Creative Workshop
summary: Practical lessons, exercises and source tools for music video, educational film, shorts, the proposed Queens Council, Blender and DaVinci Resolve.

title: Aura Disaster Resilience
summary: A shared planning and design workshop for Minjerribah information kiosks, power, communications, practical learning and local support. Field operation has separate requirements.

title: Australian Law 2012: Luke's Relevance
summary: A public account of Luke's legal reading method, a manifest of the historical corpus and a proposed source-grounded legal research engine.

title: Australian Household Bill Check
summary: Browser tools for reading contracts, annualising fees, tracing references and exporting a provider request or research brief. The collective-bargaining strand is a regional thought experiment.

title: Luke's World of Work
summary: A source-backed public account of work, education and volunteering, with an illustrated map, readable history and unresolved details made explicit.

title: Luke Nathan Hayes: The Mind Behind the Man
summary: An authored self-portrait and source collection that connects Luke's background, thinking and public body of work.

title: Lifetime Memory Map
summary: A public map of remembered places, journeys and life events. It remains a work in progress with date and evidence limits attached to individual entries.

title: World Travel Patterns
summary: A growing travel research collection for Australian passport holders, using dated checks of entry, local rules, cultural protocols, seasons and consular routes. Coverage varies by record.

title: Aura Civic Establishment
summary: Planning tools for a proposed shared civic establishment, connecting rooms, equipment, programmes, costs and an optional compute module. The site establishes no tenancy or operating service.

title: P4A Committees and Inquiries
summary: A separately hosted civic directory for parliamentary committees, inquiries and council participation, with source dates, invitation status and recorded research gaps.

title: P4A: People and Possibility
summary: A fictional browser preview of membership, groups, projects, constitution drafting and contribution records. Fictional people and records. Changes last only until this page reloads. Uses sample information only. No live membership, payments or ID verification.

title: Installing the Missing Middle
summary: A business-plan proposal for an Australian installation network combining community compute, useful heat, local ownership, co-operative participation and hardware renewal.

title: Escape Room Team Building
summary: A business-plan proposal linking immersive experiences, tourism, paid local work and whole-of-life skill development, with readable and downloadable editions.

title: Aura Teacher Training
summary: Sixty daily readings and expanded studio exercises for personal Aura development, critical engagement with AI and adult teaching. The materials are learning designs, not accreditation.

title: Aura Tourism
summary: A proposal connecting personal reflection, music, sport, culture, nature and community learning, from Minjerribah through Australia.

title: Aura Children and Young People
summary: A public proposal about personal Aura development through chosen interests, creative learning, rights, family, culture and human mentors.

title: Aura Whole of Life Support
summary: A proposal for adaptive support through dementia, disability and aged care, connecting personal records, memory, choice and human support. Clinical pathways remain distinct development work.

title: Community Club Builder
summary: A planning example for community-club capability, connecting governance, practical systems, participation and project development.

title: C-Hour Introduction
summary: An introduction and reference library for a proposed system recognising verified voluntary human contribution. One C-Hour has no monetary equivalent.
